name: cobol-diagnostic-no-severity
body: Diagnostic carries file, 1-based line/col and message but no severity, so an obsolete-level warning is told apart from an error only by its message wording ("is Obsolete under this dialect"), which the NIST parse e2e matches. Limit: severity is not structural and the line/col convention is unvalidated. Upgrade by adding a severity field to Diagnostic before any gate relies on error-level counts beyond the NIST test.
